final_native.command: ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR=zig/.zig-cache/global ~/bin/zig build --build-file zig/build.zig antfly lake-api-test -j2 --cache-dir zig/.zig-cache --prefix zig/zig-out -Dtest-filter=highlight

full_run.failures: New span assertions incorrectly required complete words at fragment edges; source intersections and the native exact selector were correct.

e2e.corrected_expectation: Every span must equal the exact source-word/fragment intersection, including clipped edges; hidden/projected results agree before and after restart with original Parquet objects unavailable.
e2e.initial_harness_invocation: Canceled after four startup-check failures: a frozen basename runtime-antfly selected the harness legacy API root. Identical executable bytes were rerun as after/antfly, selecting /db/v1.

static_checks.license_benchmark_note: Benchmark paths are outside the license scanner selected policy; their explicit Apache headers are retained. The initial combined path invocation reported this before a supported-source rerun passed.

oracle_coverage: Every successful complete hit digest agrees across both binaries and both orders, including IDs, scores, projection and highlights. Small-field and covering reports also retain equal totals. The layout runner does not retain outer total metadata. Covering assertions independently verify all 64 integer columns for 256 rows above 2^53.
qualification: Same-main local Debug binaries, old/new then new/old blocks. Seven samples per layout shape; three per small-field shape and per covering cache mode. Shared host; no task-owned build, E2E or cleanup overlapped measurements. Process restart retains OS/persistent caches and readiness warming; not empty-cache. Artifact observations count all native-store objects after readiness, including superseded objects, and do not isolate live text bytes. Publication is one observational readiness sample per run and does not isolate ingestion CPU. No Release, cloud, archive-scale, or full-query-memory qualification.

report.qualification: Warm local Debug; seven samples per shape; synthetic real Parquet with regular stride-eight 2-MiB text, 20,000 distinct prefix matches and a sparse control. Artifact bytes count every native artifact-store object after readiness, including any superseded objects; they do not isolate live text-index bytes. Compare both binary orders and complete hit digests. Publication includes table admission and readiness polling and is a single observational sample per run. No task-owned build, E2E or cleanup overlap. No Release, cloud, empty-cache or archive-scale qualification.

Warm local Debug, three samples per shape, alternating query order. Compare identical query shapes across immutable binaries; projected-wide and hidden-narrow are separate controls. No build, E2E or cleanup from this task overlaps these measurements; the host is shared. Publication is one observational readiness sample per run. Artifact bytes include all native-store objects after readiness, including superseded objects; they do not isolate live text bytes. This does not qualify cloud latency or archive scale.

report.cache_contract: Process restart retains OS and persistent caches and readiness warming; no empty-cache claim.
report.retained_report_note: Redundant per-sample ID arrays replaced by count and SHA-256; complete hit hashes and independent exact integer/ID assertions are retained by the runner. All profiles are retained.
